'''Spanner's''' was a racer bar that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
Spanner's was located in the city [[Hedrett]] and was built out of a hull section from an old [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. It had two floors and outside, a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a [[fusion wrench]] was projected over the front door.

==History==
After the [[Human/Legends|Human]] mechanic [[Moorsey]] was injured in an industrial accident, his employers paid him off and he invested the money in Spanner's. He began to work there as a bartender and employed the Human [[Tara (Human)|Tara]] and the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mykka]] as waiting staff. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited Spanner's.
